_fixture: A minimal, valid hub. Exists so the other fixtures' breadcrumbs and internal links have a real slug to resolve against — the corpus-scoped rules (r2 link resolution, r2 slug uniqueness) need a corpus, not a page.
title: Fixture Hub
metaDescription: A fixture hub page that exists so internal links in the other fixtures resolve.
answerCapsule: Fixture Hub exists so that the other fixture pages have a real internal link target to resolve against, which is what the corpus-scoped link-resolution rule needs in order to be tested at all rather than merely asserted to work inside a code comment somewhere.

sections.capsule: Fixture Hub lists the pages used by the content-lint test suite, and exists purely so that breadcrumbs and internal Markdown links in those fixtures have a real slug to point at when the corpus-scoped rules run against this directory during a test.
sections.body: See the [clean page](/herbs/fixture-clean) and the [negated page](/fixture-negated).
